h1: Do I need a permit for a fence in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Fence Permits: Height Limits, Rules and What Needs a Permit
description: Learn when Newton requires a fence permit, how state building-code exemptions interact with local fence rules, and which property conditions need review.
short_answer: Yes, a Newton fence permit is required for a perimeter fence greater than 4 feet tall. The state building code separately exempts fences not over 7 feet from its building-permit requirement, but that exemption does not remove Newton's local fence rules.

facts.text: Newton requires a fence permit before erecting a perimeter fence greater than 4 feet tall.

For a fence bordering or parallel to a front lot line, the general height limit is 4 feet. A taller fence may be allowed with additional setbacks, subject to the ordinance's maximum height and openness rules.
The tenth-edition Massachusetts building code exempts fences not over 7 feet from the building permit required under that code. This is separate from Newton's local fence permit.

qa.q: Does a fence under 7 feet automatically avoid all permits in Newton?
qa.a: No. Newton's separate fence ordinance requires a local fence permit for a perimeter fence greater than 4 feet tall.
